vehicle: Unpressurized rover; the crew rides in suits and breathes suit O2 while driving (Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicle analog).

drive_speed_mps.source: Apollo LRV speed made good, as traversed: mean 2.0 m/s (Apollo 15), 1.7 m/s (Apollo 16); the lower one is used (NTRS 20250011301, Table 1)
drive_speed_mps.note: Measured on the Moon; applying it to Gale crater terrain is a Scenario.

riding_metabolic_kj_per_h.source: Apollo 15-17 mean metabolic rate for 'Lunar roving vehicle operations', crew suited (NASA TN D-7883, Waligora et al. 1975, Table I)
riding_metabolic_kj_per_h.note: Already a suited measurement, so the suit factor kappa is not applied again. Converted to O2 with constants.json watts_to_o2_ml_per_min.

park_walk_m.source: Team choice: the rover parks this far (along the route) before the sample stop and the crew walks the last stretch, as Apollo crews parked the LRV at a station and worked on foot
park_walk_m.note: Routes shorter than this get no rover plan.

drive_path: The rover drives the engine's own walking route (every segment within slope_limit_foot_deg, below constants.json slope_limit_rover_deg); no separate rover route is computed.
